title: Deep research
before: Search-augmented answers came back in seconds from a handful of pages.
problem: Real research means dozens of sources, cross-checking and a written synthesis, which does not fit in one turn.
breakthrough: A reasoning model given browsing and many minutes to work, producing a cited report.
why: It made long-running autonomous research a mainstream product feature, copied by every major lab within months.
next: Equivalent modes in Gemini, Claude and Perplexity.
inherits: Agents that run for minutes rather than seconds.
